root_owned_changes_requested.change:
Optional foreground-only recipe:
# S2 web reliability demo + failure injections (in-process loopback; no daemon)
web-reliability-test:
    PYTHONPATH=tests python3 -m unittest test_web_reliability -v
root_owned_changes_requested.why: Operator entrypoint for the lane's test module (spec section 12 item 3); runs in the foreground only.

findings: (1) Scope holds. Running `git diff --name-only 5436b2d...HEAD` (merge-base 5436b2d, HEAD 0774709) lists exactly 6 files, all owned: tests/test_web_reliability.py, docs/spec/sprints/WEB_RELIABILITY_S2.md (section 14 is appended; `git diff 665b5ee 0774709` adds only lines 468-503), and web_reliability-{contract-freeze,handoff,real-web-job,tests}.json. No root-owned or foreign file was edited. The working tree is clean. main has moved since the merge-base, but none of the moved files are web_jobs.py, web_api.py, test_web_jobs.py, test_web_stack.py, program/capabilities.json or the owned files.

(4) Test counts reproduce. I ran the stated command with the nix FFmpeg/FFprobe exported: 'Ran 61 tests in 80.224s / OK (skipped=4)', exit 0, so 57 passed. The 4 skips are all opt-in: RealTakeWebJob, test_web_jobs.ActualDemoJob, test_web_jobs.LocalLatencyMeasurement and test_web_parity.DemoWalkthrough. test_web_demo_end_to_end_bff ran and passed on this host, as did the API demo and FI-1 through FI-11. The log is at /tmp/wr_audit_run.log.

(4) The tests check the claimed behaviour substantively. The 12 API steps and 13 BFF steps assert typed codes, store counts and tree digests (tests/test_web_reliability.py:614-879). Cancel is checked by owned PIDs gone, an empty attempt/staging directory and a signal sent to the owned process group (:743-770). Restart and reconnect are checked by field-by-field projection equality and old-token refusal (:808-829). Replay and retry keep attempt-1 byte-identical (:845-875). The duplicate audit (:877-891) checks 3 jobs, 4 attempts, 6 rows and 2 publications. One caveat: cancel, interrupt and all failure injections use the test stub worker, not the real share_export worker. worker_kind is recorded per attempt, so this is disclosed.

(6) Arithmetic checks out. Injection executions add up to 16: FI-1 2, FI-2 2, FI-3 3, FI-4 1, FI-5 3, FI-7 1, FI-8 1, FI-9 1, FI-10 1, FI-11 1. The frozen statuses add up to 11 (7 exact + 2 adapted + 1 partial + 1 not applicable), so 10 of 11 classes ran. Source decode-only packets are 3631 - 3621 = 10. byte_reduction_fraction is 1 - 22555377/230489826 = 0.902141550490823, matching exactly. run2-metrics.json shows 283 leak checks with 0 leaks, 4 node apps, 13/13 BFF steps passed, final counts {jobs 3, attempts 4, artifacts 6} and 2 publications.

(2) No forbidden writes found. The accepted run directory artifacts/runs/20261006T041633Z-990aa1bd6737 recomputes with wj.tree_digest to f641b367...fc37 over 14 entries, the same value as the receipt's before and after digests. The source sha256 is 91b2f436...4a82, as claimed. The real-take state root is under the worktree's gitignored artifacts/web-jobs/. On disk, both share.mp4 and downloaded-share.mp4 hash to 2eba932a...27db, matching the receipt. The lane did not edit program/tools.json, scripts/tool_api.py, just/workflow.just or capabilities.json; the promotion is only a request in root_owned_changes_requested. No model is downloaded, and the static test rejects fork, setsid, daemon, nohup and launchctl.

Provenance hashes match. The sha256 values of run1/run2 metrics, the run logs, real-run.log and real-web-job.json all match the values in the receipt and handoff. The committed web_reliability-real-web-job.json is semantically identical to artifacts/s2/web_reliability/real-web-job.json. The committed receipts contain no /Users, /private or token values.

(3) Claim classes are correct. Receipts mark everything as measurement_this_host_only or structural_delivery_check, with no SLO, hosted-rollout or exactly-once claims. Listening, ~32 Hz, musical and note correctness are explicit nulls with reasons. Output equality with the prior sha is recorded as observed_equal for this one run and listed under 'inferred', not claimed as determinism. FI-3's not-run sub-cases and FI-6 not_applicable are listed with reasons. Nothing is presented as real-take accuracy, and no default, profile or detector was adopted.

Minor provenance inaccuracy: web_reliability-tests.json run2 'worktree_commit' says 'bc4b55c + metrics-only edit (uncommitted at run time; committed with receipts)'. However, 0774709 does not touch tests/. The commit times (bc4b55c at 17:06:25, run1 log at 17:03, run2 log at 17:15) and the matching traceback line 903 point to run2 having run on bc4b55c itself, with the edit already folded into that commit. The label should say run2 ran on bc4b55c.

Minor: the real-take test writes its public receipt to artifacts/s2/web_reliability/real-web-job.json (OUT_DIR, tests/test_web_reliability.py:44 and :1561-1562), outside the artifacts/web-jobs/ area named in the definition of done. It is gitignored and is a JSON receipt, not media, so this is a wording deviation.

Minor: BOUND_S=1100 limits only the job poll. After a timeout the test can add a 60 s cancel poll plus a 300 s ffprobe run (:1450-1482), so the test's total wall time is not strictly 1100 s or less. The actual run took 160 s.

Minor portability: the real-take runs_root defaults to ROOT.parents[2] (:1411), which resolves to the main checkout only from a .local/sprint2/<lane> worktree. From the main checkout it fails is_dir unless WEB_RELIABILITY_RUNS_ROOT is set. It is opt-in, so this does not block.

(5) Doctrine: the lane adds no DSP. The test has no high-pass, notch or lowcut. The synthetic 32.70 Hz sine is labelled 'content only'. Every subprocess, HTTP, sqlite and poll call has a bounded timeout. Every server bound 127.0.0.1, which the static test asserts.
